title: CrossServerPuppetAttackSpec
description: Schema for cross-server Puppet attack specifications (Song et al.) where poisoned Server A weaponizes legitimate Server B.

spec_id.description: Unique identifier for the Puppet attack specification.

poisoned_server.description: Identifier of the poisoned server (Server A).

poisoned_tool_on_A.description: The specific poisoned tool exposed on Server A.

legitimate_server.description: Identifier of the target legitimate server (Server B).

legitimate_tool_on_B.description: The legitimate tool on Server B that gets weaponized.

trigger_task.description: The user prompt or operational task, appearing completely benign to the user.

harm_evidence_path.description: Filesystem path, network endpoint, or trace artifact where evidence of materialized harm is captured.

malicious_arguments_to_B.description: The specific malicious argument payload that Server A coerces the LLM to deliver to Server B.

author.description: Human author or security evaluator identifier.

puppet_mechanism.description: Technical description of how Server A's description/metadata manipulates the LLM into calling Server B.
